subtitle: Spin the rings, sink shells
description:
Whirlwhelk is a shell-matching puzzle game set in a round tide pool on a black and gold lacquer tray. Shells wash in at the rim and sink toward the swirling centre. Turn the rings of the pool to line up three or more of a kind, along a spoke or around a ring, and they spiral down into the whirl.

You never move a single shell. You turn a whole ring, and everything outside it settles inward onto its new spoke. Turn the inner ring and the whole pool reshuffles. Turn the outer ring to choose where the next shell lands. Clears make more shells sink, so one good turn can set off a chain.

The tide never stops. A new shell arrives on a steady clock and you can always see the next one. If it lands where a spoke is already full, it spills. Three spills and the tide is in. Line up four of a kind from the centre to the rim for a deep dive and win a spill back. Runs of four or more leave a wild pearl behind.

As the tide rises, urchins and sand dollars join the pool, barnacle stones clog the spokes until a match next to them breaks them up, a second wave mouth opens, and little eddies turn a ring on their own.

One finger, one round board, short sessions and a best score to beat. Plays fully offline. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.
promo: Turn the rings of a gold lacquer tide pool. Shells sink to the centre, three in a line spiral away, and one clever turn can set off a whole chain.
reviewNote: Tap to start. Drag or tap a ring to turn it; shells sink toward the centre, and three or more of a kind in a line along a spoke or around a ring clear. The game ends after three spills (a new shell arriving where its spoke is already full).
